cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Helpful Culprit
cards.instruction: Hide that the problem is your fault while enthusiastically helping investigate it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've put on rubber gloves, so I've put mine on. I'll lead the search for whoever broke your vase.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was washing up. Why is there glue on your sleeve?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, washable evidence. We'll start with the glue. I'll check every bottle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That piece stuck to your sleeve has my vase's pattern.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent match. Pass me a bag; I'll put it with the other pieces. We should concentrate on getting the whole vase accounted for.

reason: Create specific misunderstood language or copied behavior, then make the subsequent Drive tactics respond to B rather than merely add confident phrases.
